skills.name: spec-draft
skills.summary: Turns the conversation with the human into a FEAT-x.md file in the registry.

skills.name: spec-decompose
skills.summary: Breaks a feature down into the services and contracts it touches.

skills.name: acceptance-criteria
skills.summary: Generates measurable acceptance criteria for a feature.

skills.name: impact-analysis
skills.summary: Analyses the impact of contract changes on the consumers.

skills.name: dependency-graph
skills.summary: Builds the dependency graph and the delegation order (contract first).

skills.name: work-breakdown
skills.summary: Breaks a feature into per repository tasks following the graph.

skills.name: contract-update
skills.summary: Applies changes to the contracts in the registry (contract first).

skills.name: contract-validate
skills.summary: Validates the schema and cross service consistency of the registry.

skills.name: version-bump
skills.summary: Bumps the @garry/registry version after a contract change.

skills.name: design-tokens-sync
skills.summary: Synchronises design tokens between the contract and the microfrontends.

skills.name: scaffold-mfe-shell
skills.summary: Creates a microfrontend host (Vite and Module Federation).

skills.name: scaffold-mfe-remote
skills.summary: Creates a microfrontend remote (Vite and Module Federation).

skills.name: sync-contracts
skills.summary: Injects the relevant slice of contracts into .garry/ inside a repository.

skills.name: generate-types
skills.summary: Generates TypeScript types from the contracts for a given service.

skills.name: mf-wiring
skills.summary: Configures remotes, exposes and shared in Module Federation.

skills.name: review-correctness
skills.summary: Reviews a pull request for correctness.

skills.name: review-spec-match
skills.summary: Checks a pull request against the acceptance criteria.

skills.name: review-contract-compliance
skills.summary: Verifies the implementation against the contract.

skills.name: review-security
skills.summary: Security review of the changes in a pull request.

skills.name: test-unit
skills.summary: Runs and evaluates the unit tests for a repository.

skills.name: test-e2e
skills.summary: Runs the end to end tests for the assembled microfrontend.

skills.name: drift-check
skills.summary: Compares the installed contract version against the latest.

skills.name: cross-repo-merge
skills.summary: Coordinates a consistent merge of the related pull requests.

skills.name: version-tag
skills.summary: Tags the service versions after integration.

skills.name: changelog
skills.summary: Generates the changelog for a cross repository feature.

skills.name: api-contract
skills.summary: Updates the backend API contract (OpenAPI or AsyncAPI) in the registry.

skills.name: db-provision
skills.summary: Provisions a per service database from the manifest db config.

skills.name: db-migrate
skills.summary: Runs the per service database migrations.

skills.name: api-compatibility
skills.summary: Checks the implementation against the API contract (backend drift).
